interpretation: All 72 frozen endgame states and 115 actionable sides from 24 source games. Re-evaluate archived 10-second pure decisions with full-information policy-loss bounds. Preserve game clustering, forced/flat/unresolved cases. Controls are uniform legal and max damage without search; lower/upper matrix equilibrium witnesses calibrate the ceiling. Fixed-iteration current SkuctSearch c=0.4 is a separate arm, four independent search seeds; the opponent best-responds to the empirical mixture, not individual sampled seeds. The empirical mixture is not a certified estimate of the infinite-seed policy. Run the 1x/4x/16x budget ladder only on states where at least one side has a certified bad alternative (>0.02) and a certified near-optimal pure action (<=0.02). All other states keep archived-policy evaluation and unresolved status. This selection is based on the oracle and frozen before search results; it does not represent the full game or blind play. Reference stops on policy-loss accuracy or resources, never merely on root value width. No strength tuning or deployment. Final reference limits match the earlier reference maximum (60 seconds, 120000 entries); the interrupted 40000-entry development run is not pooled.
